# ============================================================
# QLI V2 Metadata - Example Config File

# Format: key = value
#   - Lines starting with '#' are comments
#   - Tensors use array syntax: key = [v1, v2, v3, ...]
#   - If a tensor is omitted, it will be auto-generated:
#       seqused_q      -> [max_seqlen_q*1, max_seqlen_q*2, ...]
#       seqused_k      -> [max_seqlen_k*1, max_seqlen_k*2, ...]
#       cu_seqlens_q   -> prefix_sum(seqused_q), starting with 0
#       cu_seqlens_k   -> prefix_sum(seqused_k), starting with 0
#       cmp_residual_k -> [0, 0, ...]
# ============================================================

# --- Required Attributes ---
soc_version   = Ascend950
num_heads_q   = 8
num_heads_k   = 1
head_dim      = 128
topk          = 8

# --- Optional Attributes ---
batch_size    = 2
max_seqlen_q  = 4
max_seqlen_k  = 128
layout_q      = BSND
layout_k      = BSND
mask_mode     = 3
cmp_ratio     = 1
quant_mode    = 0
aic_core_num  = 36
aiv_core_num  = 72

# --- Input Tensors ---
# seqused_q: actual query sequence length per batch, shape [batch_size]
seqused_q = [4, 8]

# seqused_k: actual key sequence length per batch, shape [batch_size]
seqused_k = [128, 256]

# cu_seqlens_q: cumulative query sequence lengths, shape [batch_size+1]
# If omitted, auto-computed as prefix sum of seqused_q
cu_seqlens_q = [0, 4, 12]

# cu_seqlens_k: cumulative key sequence lengths, shape [batch_size+1]
# If omitted, auto-computed as prefix sum of seqused_k
cu_seqlens_k = [0, 128, 384]

# cmp_residual_k: compression residual per batch, shape [batch_size]
# If omitted, defaults to all zeros
cmp_residual_k = [0, 0]
